question: Should harming thought be adopted in victim rite?
premises: harming thought should never be adopted
this is great benefit to bound soul
it may be unpleasant at that time
inference: victim rite should not be viewed as harming
uncertainties: whether bhavet modifies apriyaṃ or whole clause
plain_english: Never adopt a harming thought in the victim rite; this is a great benefit to the bound soul, though it may be unpleasant at that time.
